 -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:18853  CRL.P No. 14312 of 2024  HC-KAR CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY  ORAL ORDER 1.
There is no representation on behalf of the petitioner.
2. Office has raised an objection with regard to the maintainability of the petition.

The offences punishable under Sections 3(1)(r), 3(1)(s), 3(1)(w)(1), 3(2)(Va) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act (for short, 'the Act'), have been invoked against the petitioner.

sentences.text: The petitioner has got an alternative remedy of filing an appeal under Section 14A of the Act, and therefore, this petition filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023, cannot be maintained.
Registry was, therefore, justified in raising the office objection with regard to maintainability.
Petition is dismissed as not maintainable, with liberty to the petitioner to prefer an appeal as provided under Section 14-A of the Act.
3. All contentions urged are kept open.
Registry is directed to return the certified copies of the documents to the petitioner after retaining the Photostat copies of the same.

Sd/-
